description: Use as the first focused lookup when choosing a media workflow, finding reusable code or references, or diagnosing a production problem. Start with detail=compact and limit=3; skip unrelated work and simple already-supported facts. Returns saved findings, prompts, workflows and author-linked examples together, including hosted file downloads and external footage/repository/resource locations. Query with the technique, subject, model or constraint. Use detail=compact for up to 5 matching records plus 3 related records, with 4,000 body characters per record and a 64 KiB response ceiling. detail=full (also the compatibility default) allows 6 related records and 12,000 body characters. Evidence, rights and resource locations remain included; follow content_truncated records for full detail. If a broad question misses a requested resource, try up to two focused searches for its subject/model and resource kind, using types when useful; one missed query does not establish absence. Reuse supported knowledge; research remaining gaps or stale claims only. External links do not imply free access, a download or reuse rights. Anonymous public reads; no media generation or external downloads.

categories.description: Optional media category IDs from the service capability manifest.

detail.description: compact returns bounded saved content and resources; full includes more related content.

limit.description: Maximum number of results within the documented per-tool range.

q.description: Nonconfidential media task or search terms, including relevant model/version and constraints.

types.description: Optional allowed record types. Omit to search all supported knowledge types.

name: get_context
title: Reuse media knowledge and resources
